result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour, but the existing suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passed with no output from the run.

The change is one added condition in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `AND s.quantity > 0` in the `WHERE` clause. This matches how the other stock overviews already filter.

The single-product lookup (`findStockQuantity`) is untouched, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. I haven't committed anything.
